name: What is the lifespan of different pool resurfacing materials?

mainEntity.name: What is the lifespan of different pool resurfacing materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a pool surface depends heavily on the material used and proper maintenance. Standard plaster typically lasts 5-10 years. Quartz aggregate finishes offer enhanced durability, lasting 10-15 years. Pebble finishes are known for their exceptional longevity, often lasting 15-20 years or more. Tile, being the most durable, can last 20-30 years or longer. Regular cleaning, balanced water chemistry, and professional care can help maximize the life of any surface.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lifespan varies by material: plaster (5-10 years), quartz (10-15 years), pebble (15-20+ years), and tile (20-30+ years).
